title: Force NR Dual-Connectivity Status
description: Forces RadioServingSystemAO's 5G NR dual-connectivity world state, re-publishing mp/ind/radio/dc_status. Both fields optional and applied only if present (_apply_force_dc_status patches field-by-field). Enum values mirror radio.get_dc_status.rsp's, which this indication reuses. Backs taf_radio_GetNrDualConnectivityStatus and the PA's cached getDcStatus().

slot.description: Which SIM slot's DC status to force.
